sections.heading: Garage Door Spring Repair
intro: A snapped torsion or extension spring is the most common reason a garage door suddenly refuses to open, and it's one of the most dangerous DIY repairs you can attempt. Fast Garage Door Repair & Service Crestview replaces both spring types every day across Crestview and surrounding Okaloosa County, with the right wire-gauge spring sized for your specific door so it stays balanced and your opener doesn't burn out hauling a misweighted door.
We always swap springs in pairs even if only one broke. The unbroken spring is at the same fatigue cycle and will fail soon. One trip, one repair, no callbacks.

intro: Replacing a worn or broken garage spring quickly protects your opener, your door, and the people walking under it. Here's what you get when you call us:
bullets: Door functions safely and lifts smoothly within an hour of arrival
Correct spring wire gauge and length matched to your door weight
Both springs replaced in pairs to prevent a second callout next month
Roller and hinge inspection included so we catch other wear at the same time
Free estimates before any work begins
Upfront, transparent quote with no surprise charges

sections.heading: Why Choose Fast Garage Door Repair & Service Crestview?

sections.heading: Don't Force a Door With a Broken Spring

Call (850) 920-2243 and we'll get a tech out the same day. Free estimate, no risk.

sections.heading: Our Spring Repair Process
intro: Every spring job follows the same steps so nothing gets skipped:
